title: CombinedCycleBlock
description: Attribute to represent combined cycle generation by block configuration that shares heat recovery conversions. CT and CA unit assignments to HRSGs are recorded as CombinedCycleAssociation rows.

name.description: Name of the combined cycle block

heat_recovery_to_steam_factor.description: Factor for heat recovery to steam conversion

hrsg_heat_loss.description: Heat each HRSG of the block loses per hour for each committed CT that feeds it, taken from the recovered heat. In `fuel_units` per hour of the member units' fuel curves, which all use the same `fuel_units`.
